title: reputationframe
summary: MSUI preserves its accepted Character-page presentation while matching current Benilla's reputation behavior. The existing fifteen-row list now derives header identity from live flag 0x08, re-parents 0x20 rows under a default-collapsed Inactive group, retains synthetic Other, exact alphabetical group/row ordering, plus/minus folding, standing bands, raw-value hover, selection glow, and the At War pennant. Clicking a row opens the separately hosted 212x203 ReputationDetailFrame with DBC name/description, authored art, close X, At War, Move to Inactive, and Show as Experience Bar controls. ReputationFrameUiLaw owns that detached modal's host rectangle, corner, controls, checked marks, label positions, and the At War checkbox's exact ANCHOR_RIGHT GameTooltip seat. The long reference description now publishes as a wrapped white SetText line through the shared classic tooltip adapter even when peace-forced disables the checkbox; the protected list presentation is unchanged. The three controls send the exact 5875 messages; At War and Inactive update optimistically while watched state follows PLAYER_FIELD_WATCHED_FACTION_INDEX as the server-authoritative field. Focused ReputationFrame and GameTooltip checks pass; authenticated live visual/input verification remains.

openItems.text: Live-verify the Reputation list and detail frame at representative gameplay scales: actual/synthetic header ordering and folds, Inactive regrouping, persistent selection glow, At War pennant, description wrapping, popup overlap/z-order, the At War checkbox's wrapped white tooltip and exact right seat in enabled/disabled states, all three checkbox states and server round trips, watched main-menu bar adoption, close X, tab switch, and Escape closure.
The detached ReputationDetailFrame At War checkbox omitted current Benilla's wrapped white REPUTATION_AT_WAR_DESCRIPTION tooltip and exact ANCHOR_RIGHT owner seat.
openItems.resolution: ReputationFrameUiLaw now owns the exact description and BOTTOMLEFT-to-checkbox-TOPRIGHT tooltip seat. The modal renderer publishes a wrapped white SetText line through the shared classic GameTooltip adapter for both enabled and peace-forced disabled hover states; focused ReputationFrame and GameTooltip clinical checks pass while the protected Character-page list remains unchanged.
